narrative.overview: Droolbites is a small bakery printed on warm paper: cream background, ink-green text, one deep moss that does all the structural work, and a handful of confectionery accents (mustard, lavender, salmon, mint) that show up only as product tints, status dots and sticker-like moments. The storefront is generous and photographic. The admin is the same material, calmer and denser, with the moss moved from accent to a full-height sidebar.
keyCharacteristics: Moss is the single structural color: primary button, sidebar, strokes, selected states.
Strokes are inset rings, never layout-affecting borders.
Flat at rest; depth comes from tonal layers and hairlines.
Display type is tight and heavy; labels are mono.

rules.name: The One Structure Color Rule
rules.body: Moss carries structure; accents carry only small marks and panel tints. A screen never has two competing saturated fills.

rules.name: The Token-First Rule
rules.body: Never hard-code a hex that has a token.

rules.name: The Inverse Focus Rule
rules.body: Focus ring is ink on light surfaces; any moss or photo container sets --focus-ring to white.

rules.name: The Whole-Pixel Leading Rule
rules.body: Line-height is written in px, the pen's multiplier rounded half-up.

rules.name: The Display-Is-Bricolage Rule
rules.body: Headings, buttons and brand use font-display; never a system display face.

rules.name: The Hit-Slop Rule
rules.body: Keep the pen's visual size and extend the hit area with after:absolute after:-inset-*.

rules.name: The Hairline-Not-Border Rule
rules.body: Separators are inset shadows or inset rings, so they never change a box's size.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Floating Rule
rules.body: Only layers that float above content get a drop shadow.

dos: Do reach for tokens: bg-primary, bg-card, text-muted-foreground, inset-ring-border, rounded-sm|m|pill.
Do draw strokes as inset rings or inset shadows so sizes match the design.
Do write line-height in whole px and letter-spacing in px.
Do set [--focus-ring:var(--white)] on moss and photo containers; use outline-hidden, never outline-none.
Do use cn() (tailwind-merge) so a later class wins; reuse Button/ButtonLink/Chip/Field/StatusBadge.
Do give every new animation a motion-reduce: variant.
Do keep prices as Rp plus dot thousands and product names in English.
donts: Don't use border-* for pen strokes; it resizes the box.
Don't use rounded-s (logical corner); the 12px radius is rounded-sm.
Don't add a fourth radius or a second saturated structural color.
Don't put drop shadows on resting cards.
Don't hard-code a hex that has a token, or edit globals.css casually.
Don't shrink a control below 44px of hit area on mobile; add hit-slop instead.
